entries.title: Chat answers stay put while they are written
entries.body: When the AI answers a typed question, the conversation no longer scrolls down with every word. Your question, or the start of the answer if the question is long, stays where it was put while the rest arrives, so you can read from the first sentence; press Latest to jump to the end. The list of your conversations in Chat also shows more of each first question, with more lines for it on a phone, so chats are easier to tell apart.

entries.title: Quiz reopens at your first unanswered question
entries.body: When you come back to a set of quiz questions, it opens at the first one you have not answered, among those that "Only what I've read" allows, instead of at the start with your earlier answer showing. If you have answered them all, it opens at the first. A question you chose from the article still comes first.

entries.title: Quick search from the command bar
entries.body: On your own articles, asking the command bar to find something offers Quick search first, and choosing it opens Search. The Search box has a button to clear it, and Back returns to the view you were on. The note on thorough search gives its usual time as about ten seconds; the old figure was too long.

entries.title: Library cards hold their place as topics load
entries.body: Cards and rows in your library keep a line free for an article's topics while they load, so a card does not grow when a single line of topics arrives. Topics that wrap onto more lines can still make it taller. On a narrow screen, a wrapped line of facts on a card no longer starts with a dot.

entries.title: Arrow keys no longer stall near the end
entries.body: Near the end of an article, each press of the down arrow moved on a passage even when the page could scroll no further, so going back up took several presses that seemed to do nothing. A down press that cannot move the page no longer counts.

entries.title: Dates without a year get their margin note
entries.body: A Timeline event dated with a day and month but no year had no note in the margin beside the article. It has one, placed beside the earliest passage that mentions the event in those words.

entries.title: Tidier bar and buttons on small screens
entries.body: On a phone, a touch screen or a tightly fitted window, the bar at the bottom of an article showed the quick-search icon without its box, repeating the Search button beside it. The icon is hidden there as well; the / key still works. With Experimental features on, Remember's buttons fit on a single row at iPad width.

entries.title: Several rare failures removed
entries.body: An article whose saved outline was incomplete could fail to open, for you or for a visitor; it opens. Rarer cases are fixed: maths left undrawn in a page opened before the app was updated, a Search or Referee answer wrongly shown as failed or as from an older version of the article, and a comment's AI answer left waiting.
